problemSigns.detail: This is often the sound of a spring snapping.

problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: A broken spring provides no lifting assistance, making the door immovable.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: This indicates a clean break in the spring coil.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: This can happen if one of two torsion springs breaks, or if an opener struggles with unassisted weight.
Without spring tension, the cables can come off their drums.
